title: Why Arabako Txakolina tastes the way it does

lede.text: A valley in northern Álava with an Atlantic climate. Its txakoli has a characteristic acidity, with light bitter tones in the aftertaste.

terms.text: An aged txakoli with at least 5 months of ageing. Its certification starts on 1 May of the year after harvest.
A wine sold under one grape's name must contain at least 85% of a recommended variety.
A late-harvest wine from overripe grapes, with a natural strength above 15% alcohol.
A sparkling wine, at 20 °C a pressure of at least 3 bar and at least 10% alcohol.

chapters.title: The Ayala valley
paras: Arabako Txakolina is made in the Ayala valley, in the north of Álava.
Vineyards are always close to the wineries, no more than 3 km away.

chapters.title: Atlantic, with a southern wind
paras: The climate is Atlantic. Rain averages 899 litres a year.
From April to October, average light is 12.11 hours. The south wind blows on 170 days a year. It brings oxygen to the growing leaves.
The average temperature is 13.1 °C. The average high is 18.7 °C and the average low is 7.5 °C.
This microclimate means the grapes are picked at around 12°.

chapters.title: Soils from acid to alkaline
paras: The average pH in the vineyards is between 5.2 and 8.2. Active limestone is between 6.2 and 9.2.
This gives the wine its characteristic acidity. It also brings light bitter tones in the aftertaste.

chapters.title: Hondarribi Zuri against mildew
paras: The main white grape is Hondarrabi Zuri. The main red is Hondarrabi Beltza. Hondarrabi Zuri Zerratia (Petit Courbu) is also a main grape. Seven other varieties are authorised.
Yields are capped at 13,000 kg of grapes per hectare. The wine yield may not exceed 70 litres per 100 kg of grapes.
The varieties have small, tight bunches with thick skins. They resist mildew, which is a high risk in this wet zone.
Total acidity is 9 to 12 g/l as tartaric. Volatile acidity is under 1 g/l. The pH is around 3.
The wines are round and low in acidity. They have citrus and herbal flavours. The colour runs from green to straw yellow.
